questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

No chess is a can.

Not a single can is a horn.

Every horn is an adapter.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some adapters which are horns are chess as well.

II. No chess is a horn.

III. Some adapters are horns.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
**Given **Statements:

No chess is a can.

Not a single can is a horn.

Every horn is an adapter.

The least possible Venn diagram;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/813189d9cea9e2cdd8df476cc4d4e4dd99276ec4e0dcc67e768ebb67476298d5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some adapters which are horns are chess as well. - **False **(Because, there is no direct relation given between adapters, chess and horn, so it can be possible)

II. No chess is a horn. - **False **(Because, there is no direct relation given between chess and horn, so it can be possible)

III. Some adapters are horns. - **True **(Because, Every horn is an adapter so some adapters are also horns.)

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No code is a knuckle.

No eel is a code.

Some codes are bulldozers.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some bulldozers are codes.

(II) Some bulldozers are not knuckles.

(III) Some bulldozers are not eels.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows
All the conclusions I, II and III follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

No code is a knuckle.

No eel is a code.

Some codes are bulldozers.

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8d73b086526e2e554cf2c97e763554e54f7ed42e9ce021f1a54cd1200d5f3f0.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some bulldozers are codes. - **True **(Because, Some codes are bulldozers, so Some bulldozers are also codes)

(II) Some bulldozers are not knuckles. - **True **(Because, Some codes are bulldozers and No code is a knuckle, so Some bulldozers are not knuckles.)

(III) Some bulldozers are not eels. - **True **(Because, Some codes are bulldozers and No eel is a code., so Some bulldozers are not eels.)

So, All the conclusions I, II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"All the conclusions I, II and III follow".**

questions.question:
If ‘+’ means ‘subtraction’, ‘−’ means ‘multiplication’, ‘÷’ means ‘addition’ and ‘×’ means ‘division’, then what is the value of the following expression?

22 − 4 + 72 × 18 ÷ 31
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 22 − 4 + 72 × 18 ÷ 31 

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 −
 ÷
 ×
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 subtraction
 multiplication
 addition
 division
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 22 × 4 - __**72 ÷ 18**__ + 31 

⇒ __**22 × 4**__ - 4 + 31 

⇒ __**88**__ - 4 **__+ 31 __**

⇒ __**119 - **__**__4__** = __115__.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Select the option that indicates the correct arrangement of the given words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Rinse

2. Iron

3. Soak

4. Dry

5. Wash
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

3. Soak - This is the initial step where clothes are soaked in water to loosen dirt and stains.

5. Wash - After soaking, clothes are washed to remove dirt and stains.

1. Rinse - After washing, clothes are rinsed to remove soap and detergent.

4. Dry - Once rinsed, clothes are dried.

2. Iron - Finally, dried clothes are ironed to remove wrinkles and make them ready for wearing.

So, the order would be: '**3, 5, 1, 4, 2**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Block

2. Province

3. District

4. Country

5. Street

6. Village
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

5. Street - This is the smallest unit, representing a single roadway within a village or city.

6. Village - A village is a small community that may contain multiple streets.

1. Block - A block is a collection of buildings or areas within a district, typically found in urban settings but can be a part of villages too.

3. District - A district is a larger administrative division that contains multiple villages or blocks.

2. Province - A province is a larger administrative region that contains multiple districts.

4. Country - A country is the largest unit, containing multiple provinces.

So, the order would be: **5, 6, 1, 3, 2, 4**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
